info.name: LifeMine Careers API (Greenhouse Job Board) Jobs API

params.name: content
params.description: Include the full HTML job description (`content`) on every job.

items.docs: All currently published roles. `meta.total` carries the count (2 when observed on 2026-08-04). Pass `content=true` to include the full HTML job description on each row.

params.name: questions
params.description: Include the application-form `questions` array (8 questions observed on this board).

params.name: pay_transparency
params.description: Include pay-transparency compliance data where the role is subject to it.

items.docs: A single role, including the HTML `content`, `departments`, `offices`, GDPR `data_compliance` and — with `questions=true` — the application form questions.
